changes.variants: Several circuit variants may target the same region of the curve. Each variant must change a real circuit setting (allocation cap, precision window, padding, pass levers). Nonce-only or padding-only variants stay excluded.
changes.screening: Each variant gets one local run of the trusted public evaluator on its emitted ops.bin. The evaluator draws its 9,024 shots from the operation hash, so this run equals the public check for those bytes. A failed screen ends that variant. No variant is screened twice.
changes.order: Screen first. A passing variant then gets the full sealed reference run, then its 20,480-pair audit, then submission.
changes.failure_rate: Variants may fail more often than our earlier circuits, up to the audit bound of 0.001 per input.
changes.disclosure: Each public note states how many variants were screened for that region, how many failed, and the audited failure rate of the submitted circuit.

unchanged: epsilon 0.001 per input, 20,480-pair audit before submission
